arrival_rule: Minute 0 is the anchored arrival (T = 1, the authored SBP / DBP exactly); minute 1 keeps T = 1 (the target read on the arrival state is 1); from minute 2 on T answers the previous minute's state. The arrival BP is never used to infer the gain: it is exact by construction.

baroreflex_plan.double_counting: the acute signal drives both tone and the sympathetic drive; a pressure deficit falls with output and rises less once tone supports it, so the baroreflex term reads MAP after tone; their shared variance on the arrival surface is reported before any value
baroreflex_plan.requires: faculty pressure envelopes (A, B, F) and a tone decision first; then a MAP set point and a baroreflex gain range authorized before any value; then the P2I-2AK A-F rules repeated
baroreflex_plan.signal: the absolute MAP the pressure domain now derives with dynamic tone (mmHg, anchored on the authored arrival), against a faculty set point: max(0, MAP_set - MAP) / MAP_set, never the arrival-relative 1 - p
baroreflex_plan.status: DEFERRED: pressure -> HR stays PRESSURE_TERM_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY (0 in the primary HR profile); not reconnected in P2J-2
baroreflex_plan.tone_interaction: tone already answers the acute deficit and supports pressure; a baroreflex acting on HR must not also act on T through the same deficit (one tone writer only: the core fails closed on a second one), and its gain is explored jointly with the acute HR gain and the tone gain

demand_rule: The signal reads demand (s = deficit / demand, and s0 = 1 - ratio / demand at arrival), so tone, output, pressure, delivery, D and lactate now depend on the demand factor and on the lactate side's arrival delivery level: demand 1.0 and 1.1 are carried separately, each with its own retained units, and never pooled or chosen.
envelope_rule: Each proposal shows the model distribution (LOW / median / HIGH over the retained keys, per gain at a = 0.3 and per demand), the T = 1 reference, the physiological rationale, its sensitivity to the gain (the medians across gains), to a (the sample at a = 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.5) and to demand (1.0 against 1.1), and the basis of any bound: PHYSIOLOGICAL for a direction the physiology fixes, EXPLORATORY for a number (none is proposed: no authored pressure exists beyond arrival, so a number would come from the model itself), EVIDENCE for an authored observation (none). No envelope is applied or approved.

A.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
A.question: untreated 57m SBP / MAP at 120
A.rationale: ongoing haemorrhage with compensatory vasoconstriction: pressure supported against the T = 1 reference, never normalized (direction 5)

B.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
B.question: untreated 72f SBP / MAP at 120

C.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
C.question: pressure response to crystalloid
C.rationale: MAP at the minute the crystalloid volume reaches its total less MAP the minute before it starts (net of the bleeding meanwhile); tone falls as delivery recovers, so the response is smaller than at T = 1

D.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
D.question: pressure response to the first PRBC unit
D.rationale: MAP at the minute the first unit completes less MAP the minute before it starts (net)

E.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
E.question: pressure response to the second PRBC unit
E.rationale: MAP at the minute the second unit completes less MAP at the first unit's completion (net)

F.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
F.question: pressure at 120 after successful definitive resuscitation
F.rationale: deficit resolved, so the acute tone is withdrawn: what remains above arrival is output

G.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
G.question: acceptable T during shock
G.rationale: the vasoconstriction an untreated haemorrhage reaches, on the arrival scale and on the no-deficit scale

H.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
H.question: acceptable T at 120 after adequacy
H.rationale: the tone left once delivery is adequate: T_abs = 1 when no deficit remains

I.basis: PHYSIOLOGICAL (direction); EXPLORATORY (no numeric bound proposed); no EVIDENCE beyond arrival
I.question: acceptable output / DO2 penalty from vasoconstriction
I.rationale: output and delivery against the T = 1 reference on the same key (fractional change), the effective deficit and D change: the price of the pressure gained

faculty.afterload: a = 0.3 provisional with 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.5 exploratory; none approved; a sparse tone_gain x a design
faculty.arrival: the authored arrival BP stays exactly 88/54 (57m) and 98/62 (72f) at minute 0; the response begins from the anchored arrival state; arrival BP never infers the gain
faculty.demand: 1.0 and 1.1 carried separately unless the signal is invariant to demand; never one chosen
faculty.hr: pressure -> HR stays DEFERRED; no HR latent selected; P2I-2AK A-F read as a diagnostic, never a filter
faculty.lactate: faculty lactate rules unchanged, never recalibrated; if every tone candidate violates the certified lactate physiology, stop
faculty.loop: the T -> afterload -> Q -> DO2 -> deficit -> T loop is audited; deterministic, no hidden iterative convergence, no oscillation, no evaluation-order dependence; a same-step algebraic closure without a guaranteed unique solution stops the package, and no iterative solver is added
faculty.no_memory: no accumulated D as a tone driver: tone answers the current acute deficit
faculty.no_pressure_driver: T is never driven by 1 - relative pressure or another pressure error in P2J-2 (circular before the baroreflex set point and gain exist)
faculty.range: a small gain range (about 4-6 values, 0 included as the synthetic reference) from T_base, the T domain [0.1, 3.0], the normalized deficit range of the certified physiology, broad vasoconstrictor plausibility and fixed-state probes; never from legacy BP, a desired BP or survivor counts; frozen before outcomes
faculty.scope: shadow only; no runtime integration, GI or second-family migration, final tone or afterload approval, hard BP envelope, pressure -> HR reconnection, RR calibration, consciousness recalibration, collapse activation or legacy fitting
faculty.semantics: T_base = 1 and a non-negative acute vasoconstrictor increment, T_target = 1 + gain x signal within the T domain; no case-specific offset; no dependence on lactate, HR or legacy pressure; a smooth monotone saturation if one is needed, never a hard clamp as the primary mapping
faculty.structure: P2J-1's mapping is STRUCTURE_APPROVED: p = Q x T, SBP = arrival SBP x max(0, p), DBP = arrival DBP x max(0, p), MAP proportional to p; the p = 0.5 knee and the 45 / 25 mmHg gains stay retired. Not approved: the numerical BP trajectories, T = 1 as clinical physiology, a tone gain, an afterload parameter, any BP envelope
faculty.timing: test an instantaneous common response first (deterministic, no algebraic instability, smooth minute to minute); a response time constant is not authorized: if one is structurally required, stop
faculty.tone: a COMMON dynamic vascular-tone response; primary acute driver the normalized effective oxygen deficit (effective_oxygen_deficit / demand, or an exactly equivalent normalized deficit already in the core); deficit 0 -> acute contribution 0; a larger deficit never lowers the vasoconstrictor contribution; no GI-specific or case-specific coefficient, no legacy BP fitting

feedback.bound: in a deficit s = 1 - R, R = reserve x delivery / demand < 1, and dR/dT = -a R / (1 + a (T - 1)), so dF/dT = g a R / ((1 + g s0)(1 + a (T - 1))) < g a / (1 + g s0 (1 - a)) <= g a (T >= 1 / (1 + g s0)); outside a deficit dF/dT = 0. g a < 1 makes F a contraction: one fixed point for a steady state, approached monotonically, no oscillation; the amplification at the fixed point is 1 / (1 - dF/dT)
feedback.determinism: no solver, no iteration inside a minute, no clock or random input; contributors are read from the same start-of-minute state in a fixed order (integration.step), and the tone delta reads only that state, so the result never depends on evaluation order
feedback.loop: T -> afterload 1 / (1 + a (T - 1)) -> output Q -> delivery -> s -> T, closed one minute behind
feedback.map: with the blood state, rhythm and FiO2 given (none reads T or anything derived from it), T(m+1) = F(T(m)) = (1 + g s(T(m))) / (1 + g s0); s rises when T rises (T lowers Q), so F is non-decreasing: the loop is positive feedback and can never alternate in sign
feedback.same_step: not used: a same-minute reading would make T an algebraic fixed point T = F(T) of the minute's own output (no solver is authorized); the explicit scheme converges to that fixed point while the upstream is steady

identifiability.rule: WELL_CONSTRAINED: fixed by an authored observation; PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED: bounded by an approved rule or structure but not fixed; POORLY_IDENTIFIED: the observations move it only weakly or jointly; NON_IDENTIFIABLE: nothing observed reaches it. The case data hold one pressure per case (arrival, exact by construction) and no output, resistance or post-arrival pressure.

T trajectory: T is never observed; given g its shape is fixed by the certified signal (s from delivery and demand), so it is identified only once g is
afterload a: reaches pressure and output only through T != 1, and no output or resistance is observed; with dynamic tone a and g act jointly (pressure ~ T / (1 + a (T - 1)) with T set by g), so even pressure envelopes would constrain the pair, not a
pressure / output composite: MAP = arrival MAP x Q x T: at arrival WELL_CONSTRAINED by anchoring (exact by construction), beyond arrival nothing observed; output is fixed by the certified blood physiology at T = 1 and moves with tone only through a
tone gain: no authored pressure, output or resistance after arrival, and the arrival pressure is exact by construction at every gain (T = 1 there): nothing observed reaches g. Bounded only structurally (g a < 1, 1 + g <= 3); faculty envelopes A, B and F would make it PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED (their sensitivity to g is reported)

literal_alternative_rule: The literal channel T = 1 + g s with T = 1 anchored at arrival (no arrival normalization) is rejected analytically (ANALYTIC_REJECTION, ARRIVAL_DISCONTINUITY): at any arrival with a deficit (s0 > 0) its first update jumps T from 1 to 1 + g s0 with no change in the patient, raising pressure by (1 + g s0) / (1 + a g s0) in one minute (``literal_alternative``); removing the step would need a response time constant, which is not authorized.
policy: Shadow only. P2J-1's committed record and the P2I-2AJ / P2I-2AK machinery; legacy pressure never read (no shadow, legacy adapter or family-engine import), the P2F region never consumed (P2FGuard), no hard pressure envelope, nothing approved or selected, pressure -> HR not reconnected, lactate never recalibrated.

probes.rule: Fixed states, before any trajectory: two arrivals, the neutral probe arrival (s0 = 0) and the 57m arrival at the lower delivery level and demand 1.0 (s0 = 0.4), at reserve 2.5. 1: deficit 0 gives T_abs = 1 exactly. 2: T's target never falls as s rises (pump lowered step by step at T = 1). 3: at a fixed preload, pump and rhythm, output falls as T rises, for every afterload point. 4: p = Q x T rises with T over the whole guard. 5: a steady upstream (pump lowered, nothing else acting, 60 minutes) gives T monotone, its step shrinking at no more than the slope bound, settling on the analytic fixed point (bisection here, never in the core). 6: when the deficit resolves (pump raised) T returns to T_abs = 1. 7: no pulse, no pressure, the target in the guard; output 0 with a pulse still stops the run; a tiny output at the largest tone gives a tiny pressure. 8: no pressure is negative, and minute 1 equals the arrival.

range_rule: Built before any trajectory, from: T_base = 1 and T's guard [0.1, 3.0]; the normalized acute signal of the certified physiology (P2J-1's sample at T = 1: s0 0 to 0.45 at arrival, s up to 0.74 untreated at 120, 0 once resuscitated), so 1 + g s spans 1 to 1 + 0.74 g; broad vasoconstrictor plausibility (in severe haemorrhagic shock systemic vascular resistance rises to about 1.5-2.5 times its unstressed value, so g up to 2 at s near 0.7 spans the range); and the fixed-state probes. 0 is the synthetic no-response reference (P2J-1's T = 1), kept diagnostic, not a primary candidate; 2 is the largest gain whose largest target 1 + g stays inside the guard. Neither a legacy BP, a desired BP nor a survivor count is read. Every gain is crossed with the three afterload points (the pairwise surface), then screened analytically.
timing: Option A, instantaneous: each minute T takes the target the state at the start of the minute calls for, T(m+1) = tone_target(state(m)) (the delta is the target minus T(m)). No time constant: the only lag is the integration step, which the debt D already uses (its deficit is read at the start of the minute). The minute after arrival keeps T = 1 exactly, because the arrival state is the target's fixed point: tone starts to move at minute 2, answering the minute-1 state.

tone.absolute: tone relative to the tone with no deficit: T_abs = 1 + g x s (g = deficit_to_tone_gain >= 0); T_abs = 1 exactly at no deficit, non-decreasing in s, linear: no saturation is needed because 1 + g <= 3 (ANALYTIC_RULES) keeps it inside T's guard
tone.channel: the T channel is relative to arrival (proposal §7.2, P2J-1's anchoring): T = T_abs / T_abs(arrival) = (1 + g s) / (1 + g s0), s0 = derived.arrival_tone_signal (the arrival delivery against the case's baseline demand). T = 1 at arrival exactly, so the authored arrival pressure stays the scale of the accepted mapping and the arrival state is the response's own fixed point; T > 1 while the deficit exceeds arrival's; T = 1 / (1 + g s0) once no deficit is left (T_abs = 1). s0 is read from the arrival state, never fitted: no case offset is chosen
tone.core: derived.tone_target (the target), integration._vascular_tone (the delta, source core_coupling:vascular_tone); deficit_to_tone_gain 0 writes no delta, so every run before P2J-2 is unchanged
tone.signal: s = effective_oxygen_deficit(demand, delivery, reserve) / demand, read on the state (derived.acute_deficit_signal, P2I-2AF; the same signal the sympathetic drive reads): 0 when oxygen availability is adequate or compensated, non-decreasing as the effective deficit grows, at most 1 (no delivery); it reads delivery and demand only

tradeoff_rule: Per admissible (gain, a), predeclared: UNSTABLE_FEEDBACK when a SIMULATION_RULES rejection occurs on any key; else PRESSURE_SUPPORTED_AT_DELIVERY_COST when a retained unit that passes FD-LAC and L3 adequacy at T = 1 fails them with the tone response (a faculty-approved outcome lost to the delivery the tone takes); else PRESSURE_SUPPORTED_WITH_STABLE_DELIVERY. The continuous costs (output, delivery, deficit and D against the T = 1 reference) are reported for every pair, with no threshold: the faculty sets the acceptable cost (envelope I). At a = 0.1 and 0.5 the FD-LAC part reads the sample units only (SAMPLE_ONLY).

verdict.rule: READY when: the tone semantics are coherent (probes 1, 2 and 6, T = 1 at minutes 0 and 1 on every key, the gain-0 reference equals P2J-1's pressure); the feedback is deterministic and stable (probe 5, no SIMULATION_RULES rejection on any admissible pair, repeat runs identical); no pathological pressure / output loop (no UNSTABLE_FEEDBACK); the current lactate constraints stay satisfiable (at each demand some admissible gain > 0 at a = 0.3 keeps at least one retained candidate through FD-LAC and L3 adequacy); the candidate distributions exist for P1-P4, both cases and demands, every admissible gain; the reconstruction equals the core on the sample; the retained units are P2I-2AK's and, at gain 0, every one of their candidates keeps FD-LAC and L3 adequacy (the lactate reference reproduced); pressure -> HR stays 0 in the primary profile; and nothing is approved. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing check as the blocker.
